phase: ROADMAP Stage 6 (third item): governance skeleton v1 — encryption metadata, backup/restore manifests, retention policy, and audit-log records (no real crypto/backup/delete)
summary: Added a deterministic, stdlib-only Stage 6 governance skeleton. build_encryption_policy records algorithm/key_source/status metadata and never key material (validator rejects key/secret/password/private_key/passphrase fields). build_backup_manifest computes deterministic sha256 checksums (sort_keys) over provided content with a per-manifest checksum; build_restore_plan derives ordered verify/unverified steps plus warnings without executing a restore. build_retention_policy lists deletion CANDIDATES by artifact-type age windows but deletes nothing. build_audit_record normalizes timestamp/actor/action/workspace_id/resource/result/reason; validator requires actor+action and rejects secret fields. build_governance_policy summarizes the defaults. HTTP GET /api/governance/policy and POST /api/governance/audit/validate; a front-end 设置 panel section surfaces the policy. No real encryption, no destructive delete, no backup/restore execution, no network, no credential/.env read.
implemented: backend/server.py: added GOVERNANCE_ENC_ALGORITHMS, GOVERNANCE_KEY_SOURCES, GOVERNANCE_AUDIT_RESULTS, GOVERNANCE_ARTIFACT_TYPES, GOVERNANCE_FORBIDDEN_KEY_FIELDS, and _governance_checksum (sha256 over sort_keys JSON).
backend/server.py: build_encryption_policy/validate_encryption_policy (metadata only; validator rejects key-material fields and unknown algorithms).
backend/server.py: build_backup_manifest/validate_backup_manifest (deterministic per-entry + manifest sha256 checksums; duplicate-name and empty-list checks).
backend/server.py: build_restore_plan/validate_restore_plan (ordered steps, verify_and_restore vs restore_unverified, warnings; no execution).
backend/server.py: build_retention_policy/validate_retention_policy (per-type day windows + deletion-candidate report; non-negative-int validation; deletes nothing).
backend/server.py: build_audit_record/validate_audit_record (auto timestamp; actor+action required; known result; rejects secret fields; warns on missing workspace_id).

README.md and docs/ROADMAP.md document the v1 boundary; only the ROADMAP '加密、备份、恢复、保留期和审计日志' item is marked done (provider-risk/SBOM untouched).
not_implemented: No real encryption/decryption engine; encryption is policy metadata only.
No destructive delete; retention only reports deletion candidates.
No real backup copy or restore execution; manifests and plans are metadata only.
No audit-log persistence store; records are built/validated but not stored.
No model-provider data-flow risk grading or SBOM/dependency-locking (later Stage 6 items). No network, no secret/.env read.

risks: Encryption is declarative metadata only: build_encryption_policy asserts nothing is actually encrypted. A reader must not infer real at-rest protection from status=declared.
Backup manifests checksum only the content passed in; they do not read the filesystem, so a manifest can be complete yet no bytes are actually backed up.
Retention reports deletion candidates but performs no deletion and enforces no schedule; acting on candidates is left to a future, deliberately-gated step.
Audit records are built and validated but not persisted or tamper-evidenced (no hash chain); this is a record schema, not an append-only audit store.

Environment note: the local interpreter is python3 (no bare 'python' on PATH); the quality-gate runner honors PYTHON=python3, and a local 'python->python3' PATH shim lets its default-interpreter meta-test pass.
credentials: No credentials or .env files were read, created, or modified; encryption policy and audit validators explicitly reject key/secret/password fields.
No external network calls were used for implementation or local tests.
